title: 第2558章 谈判破裂第2557章 地主之谊
content_zh:
第2558章谈判破裂！
“好，好，好，还得是你们大长老会来事！”
“懂男人要什么。”
吴元奎刚要打瞌睡，就有人送枕头上门。
正中下怀。
眯着眼睛享受。
用心感受那凶屯丰满，少妇气质拉满貌美人妻，冰凉玉手在脖颈上悄然游走感觉。
舒服的浑身打颤。
动作稍稍一大，迅速惹来腰上坐着血族少妇掩嘴嘲笑：
“您.......不会交代了吧？”
“这地宫建的早，没接自来水，可不好洗哦~”
“要去井口那里才行。”
吴元奎年纪大归年纪大，一身肾气却精纯的很。
老当益壮。
不是那人才十几二十岁，肾却透支的厉害。
脆皮年轻人能比。
洋荤都没开到，怎么可能闹出那种有辱华夏雄风洋相。
双手一撑转身，让其体验体验什么叫猛龙过江时候。
突然想到件事。
笑着问腰上坐着血族少妇：

“你们这次安排，一共派出几个人，都去了哪些人屋子？”
少妇身材很顶，情商比身材还顶，压着强龙笑嘻嘻张口：
“这是个秘密。”
“不能说的哦！”
悟苦大师对别的事不怎么精通，对这一道却颇有研究。
既然是报恩。
全队这么多男人，不可能只报他一个。
其他人肯定也有份。
老太尉、秦木头他们吃不吃送到嘴边肉，他不关心，只关心臭棋篓子有没有破戒。
挠着细柳腰肢问逼，惹来血族少妇吃不住痒。
哈哈大笑求饶：
“真的不能说。”
“说了要吃棍子的。”
吴元奎在别的事上鲁莽，直来直往，一遇上这种事，整个人就跟打通任督二脉一样大变样。
当场化身足浴店老手，挠着腰肢老不正经调情：
“你不说就不吃了吗？”
......
是夜。
沉寂四百年地殿客房，爆发出两场惊天动地中西大战。
content_en:
Chapter 2558 Negotiation breaks down!
"Okay, okay, okay, it's up to your Grand Elder Council to do this!"
"Understand what men want."
Just as Wu Yuankui was about to take a nap, someone sent a pillow to his door.
Just right.
Squint and enjoy.
Feel the fullness of the ferocious vagina with your heart, the temperament of a young woman and the beauty of a beautiful wife, and feel the cold jade hands quietly roaming around the neck.
Shivering all over in comfort.
The movement was slightly larger, and the young vampire woman sitting on her waist covered her mouth and laughed:
"You...can't explain it, right?"
“This underground palace was built early and has no running water, so it’s not easy to wash~”
"We have to go to the wellhead."
Wu Yuankui is old, but his kidney energy is very pure.
Get older and get stronger.
Not that he was only in his teens or 20s, but his kidneys were severely overdrawn.
Crispy young people can compare.
There was no meat available, so how could it be possible to make such a show that insulted China's majesty?
He turned around with both hands and let him experience what it means when a dragon crosses the river.
Something suddenly occurred to me.
He smiled and asked the young vampire woman sitting on his waist:
"How many people did you send out this time? Which houses did they go to?"
The young woman has a very good figure, and her emotional intelligence is even better than her body. She smiles and opens her mouth under Qianglong:
"It's a secret."
"It can't be said!"
Master Wu Ku is not very proficient in other things, but he has studied this one quite a lot.
Since it is repaying a favor.
There are so many men in the team, it's impossible to just reward him.
Others must have had their share.
He didn't care whether Old Taiwei, Qin Muzi, or the others ate the meat that was served to their mouths. He only cared about whether the stinky chess basket had broken the precepts.
He scratched the thin willow waist and asked about it, which made the young vampire woman feel itchy.
Laughing loudly and begging for mercy:
"I really can't say."
"I said I wanted to eat a stick."
Wu Yuankui was reckless and straight-forward in other matters, but when something like this happened, his whole person changed as if he had opened up the two channels of Ren and Du.
On the spot, he transformed into a foot bath shop veteran, scratching his waist and flirting inappropriately:
"You won't eat it if you don't tell me?"
...
It's night.
In the guest room of the Earth Palace that had been dormant for four hundred years, two earth-shattering wars between China and the West broke out.
